subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google presents Vertex AI as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but the correct replacement wording is not deterministic and provider IDs must remain stable unless maintainers choose a migration.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update user-facing labels and docs to the current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter's shorter requested label even though it does not match the official page title checked in this review.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave the existing label until Google SDK/API/docs naming settles further or maintainers want a broader provider-name migration.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update user-facing labels and docs to the current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest issue discussion points to this handle for UI/UX and docs labeling direction, which is the unresolved blocker here.
